content: Isu auki nakiyena puntika abe'isaenaba kasiyo
Pigoya, Karaisitiba ae'wa nkau'wata auki nakiyena maentika, pika napiyisa puma tigeba napiyiyo. Piya, wasanamaba au'wata auki nakiyena maeyamipa, aguntaena pusanagaba kampa napiye.
Piya pumagina, ae'wa nkau mampabi waikena pekanaba, aeba wasanami nki'ni ntapiyenaba kampa aega'ma, aeba Koti nkabemintanaba wasima miyeno.

We, paipa tigeba to marisa kina'mi nkibugaintanara nasisu pumagiri, kumiyena puma, tigu'amapa i'nintana potamagiri, esegi wani ntama aibo'nabo pumagiri, ata patiyena puma, aibo'ena pumagiri, kamana akayuma ama kotintana aegarantapa, ibaba a'ya wakiripa ataiyo.
Piya, tigeba pi nkagasiya kamparagaena pukenagaba kampa igetiba uma atokaeyaginiba, pika igeba ata pami puma kamparaga puritawe.
We, aintiba pu'wanta kinape taogantompe kinape kamanatepa uma a'yigitatakena yagaramati igeba ige'wai nkagowaipa aborakibewe.

We, paipa pu'wanta kina'mi nka'yigitakenaraka pu'wanta kina'mitiba uma aogi kamanapa aborantine. Eya, igeba a'ya'ma kina pesa puma ige'wai nkitasa antota'enaba maema pu'wantapa, Koti miyisa puma misanaga imawaimpaba kamanapa aborantine.
Koti nkesegiyenarasa aogi yuga puma tiyo'ena piyo
Pigoya, a'ya'maena nagarikena kanapa pabigo arosaye. Piyama, tigeba aogima ntapima, nunamu ukenaraka asoyaena piyo.
Tigeba tiyo'mi agu kao'ena puwaitakenaenaba aogima upebe puyaba miyiyo. Pintanamaba tonaba agasaye. Piya, agu kao'ena potakenaenamaba agasima uwoma aguntaenaba airari kaeye.
Tigeba tiyekitaenaba a-pumagiri, tiyo'mipa aogima maruntana puma kabiwaitaiyo.
Kotiba awagaenawapisa tonarona a'muntanaba ka ka kina'miti timegiripa, a-kakatama, pitasa aogi mono yuga puma tiyo'mipa iyo'maeyiyo.

Piya, ka'wainaba kamana uma aborakibipa, pipa Koti nkawaga kamana uma aborano. To ka'wainaba wasana ao'maekibipa, pipa Koti nkamemi nkesegiyenarasa ao'maeyano. Eya, a'ya'maenagaba Isu Karaisiti ntugarasa Koti nkagiga'e asagayukenagaba aogi yuga piyo. We, e'wasaenabe esegiyenabe a'ya'ma yaga aeti waiyabane. Tagane.
Karaisitikaba tauki nakiyena maekune
We, nabugai ntao'mitaba, tigetiba yaku tasu puma timiyo'ena pukenaenaba aborakiye. Piya, kasa'ena wanane. Pipa tige agoripa aogima aborakena piye. A-pami piyo.
Piya, tigeba Karaisiti nkauki nakiyenaba kaga maema aesaga peka ti'mu piyo. Eya, aintiba e'wasaenawapa aborakiripa, tigeba to ka tinta asoyaena puma ti'mu pukibewe.
Tigeba Karaisiti nkagera iyekita puritaigiripa, Koti akayona puritakiye. We, e'wasaenama Nkawamusa, Koti Nkawamusa'ama tigeti ago miya, ti'mu piyo.

Pigoya, tige tikapisa ka'wainati auki nakiyena aborakibipa, a'yugu wasanama aegunta'enarasawo, kuntanarasawo, ataenawatasawo, to waina ntanari ara agata nasikibi ntanarasawoma aborakiye. Piya puta nasekiniba igeba antota'enawapa taga aboramikibewe.
We, ka yagarama Karaisiti nkaegarakenaga auki nakiyena maentanaba, aeba anipa a-peno. Aeba Karaisiti nkaegarakenagaba napima Koti nkage asagayuyeno.
Pigoya, Koti utaratakena yagaba agarosagina, marupa Koti nkaokina'miteti kamanapa aborakiye. We, taete nkagoba marupa aboragaitegina, Koti kamana akayuye kina'mitiba ayabaya puma a'ya pukiye.
Pika mono isa'amaba maya iye:

content.text: Arupu kina i'ikenaba kunta pikana, Koti ikabitate aguntaena pe kina'miba ae nkauka'ibaya mikibewe, a, piya iye.

content: Piya pegini, wasamiba Koti nkabemika iki nakiyenaba maeyapa, aogiyena puma a'ya'maena aboratanti ntagarama nkayapi imawaipa ataigina, aeba tagantana puma kabiritano.
